I use a Canon camera and I'm looking for a structured instruction session to improve my skills. I prefer a fast pace and would really enjoy having plenty of gear talk during our time together. Regarding the technical side, I'm looking for someone to teach me post-processing. In terms of the shoot, I am fine with not taking portraits of each other. I'm currently free on Saturday mornings to make this happen. I'm excited to dive into the technicalities and get some high-energy practice in!
